llm_response.reason: The website claims to sell Chiara Ferragni brand items but uses an unrelated domain (lexiegavin.shop) rather than an official one. This is impersonation and spoofing of a legitimate brand. The site has broad, unfocused product offerings; uses urgency and psychological lures; does not provide proper business credentials or contact info; and lacks clear privacy and company information. None of the signs point to legitimate operation. This matches multiple scam website characteristics, especially in the Fake Online Shopping category.
